The '''Fireball Belch''' was a [[Pyrokinesis|pyrokinetic]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] utilized by the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]]. His first demonstration of the ability occurred by accident when, after having an immense brunch and downing a barrel of [[Gamorrean hooch/Legends|Gamorrean hooch]], he burned his clan-rival [[Scumbo/Legends|Scumbo]]'s snout.<ref name="Barely">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|series=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> Thok would later use it to great effect while acting as a student of [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] under the teachings of [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Arden Lyn]].<ref name="Masters">''[[Star Wars: Masters of Teräs Käsi]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Fireball Belch was one of Thok's moves in the fighting game ''[[Star Wars: Masters of Teras Kasi]]''. Although the game itself was canon due to introducing characters as Arden Lyn, the move's status as either canon or simply gameplay mechanics was debated until the release of Part 2 of [[Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire]], which confirmed the ability as canonical.
